verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Are you looking for mercy?
Forgiveness for your sins?

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Are you fighting the battle?
Struggling to win?

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines: Are you tired and lonely, searching in vain?

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: Holding back a part of you that causing all the pain?

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Come to the cross do not be afraid
Jesus is waiting to take the pain away

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Come to the cross do not hesitate
Jesus is waiting today
